error.title: The interface ran into an error
error.safe: Your files, settings and running tasks are not affected. Try again first; if that does not help, try the other buttons in order.
error.resetNote: Restoring the default interface resets only the appearance and layout. Your data is not affected.
error.hint: When reporting the problem, please include the error details below.
error.copyFailed: Copy failed. Please select the text and copy it manually

overview.title: TRM UI
overview.sub: A shared interface and control examples for desktop apps
overview.whatBody:
TRM UI is the interface foundation for desktop apps: shared colours and type sizes, common controls, interface text in eight languages, a window with a sidebar, and project settings that run as they are.
The src/trm/ folder can be copied into a new project as a whole.
overview.whyBody:
Every product uses the same interface, so colours, controls and motion stay consistent.
Interface improvements are made in TRM UI first and then synced to each product.
overview.rule1: Colours come only from the shared colour variables, never from literal colour values. A literal colour displays incorrectly in the other theme.
overview.rule2: Interface text comes only from the language packs. The build checks that all eight languages have the same entries.
overview.rule3: The src/trm/ folder uses only its own code, so it can be copied to another project as a whole.
overview.themeTip: With "Follow system", the interface switches with the system's light or dark setting.
overview.langTip: All eight languages are built in; the interface text updates as soon as you switch.

shell.title: Window frame
shell.web: This is a web preview. Window buttons, the tray and saving settings are available only in the desktop app.
shell.sourceTip: Where the current interface files are loaded from. When the program folder contains a frontend folder, the files in it are used first.
shell.autostartTip: Starts the app automatically after you sign in to Windows.

components.sub: All controls below can be operated.
components.buttonsNote: A button that is processing shows three bouncing dots.
components.segmentNote: Click an option or drag the thumb to switch.

field.name: Display name
field.nameTip: The name shown in the interface.
field.deviceDesc: A saved device that is currently unavailable is marked as unavailable.
field.volumeNote: Snaps to the nearest mark on release.

list.item1Body: The details appear when expanded. Click again to collapse.
list.item2Desc: The right side holds a button, a switch or a status label.

type.sub: Body text is 15px with a line height of 1.65. Only the sizes below are used.

color.sub: Every colour has to be checked in both the light and the dark theme.

motion.easeNav: For page changes and large movements. Starts fast, decelerates over a long tail and never passes the end point.
motion.spring: For small elements such as popovers and thumbs. It passes the end point slightly and settles back, so it is not used on elements that touch the window edge.
motion.ease: For ordinary transitions such as hover, press and colour changes.
motion.easeSoft: Starts gently and comes to a slow stop. For fades and small movements.
motion.springSettle: A spring that never passes the end point. For large changes of shape.
motion.springGentle: Passes the end point by about 1%. For small movements.
motion.springBouncy: Passes the end point by about 8%. Only for small scale changes.
motion.flowSub: When a task has finished and has not been viewed, a moving light runs along the bottom.
motion.nudgeBody: The notice rises from the bottom; once it closes, the content below moves up.
motion.modalBody: The dialog rises and grows when it opens, and shrinks and fades when it closes.
motion.drawerBody: The drawer slides in from the right to show details on the current page.
motion.curvesHint: Click a row to play that curve.
motion.glassHint: Click an option or drag the thumb. When dragged quickly to one end, the thumb squashes and springs back.

patterns.sub: Interface patterns common in desktop applications. All of them can be operated.
patterns.warnLine: Needs 14 GB of VRAM; this machine has 12 GB
patterns.modalText: Click outside the dialog or press Esc to close it.
patterns.drawerText: Opens from the right to show details on the current page.
patterns.noticeText: Click this notification to see the details.
patterns.pagerNote: On a page change, the content moves in the paging direction and the page numbers move to their new positions.

inter.sub: Examples of in-page switching, comments, step-by-step guides, notices, errors, ring charts, panels and floating buttons.
inter.c1: The instructions are clear; it worked the first time.
inter.c2: On a slower computer it takes a while.
inter.stepBody: Click Next when this step is complete.
inter.notice1: Report problems on the issue page.
inter.notice2: Generate a diagnostic package and attach it before you submit.
inter.panesNote: Tabs switch with a push; filtering the same list uses a flow list.

set.sub: Settings fall into three groups: Appearance, General and Shortcuts. A change that needs a restart shows a notice at the top.
set.wallpaperNote: Static images are supported. Large images load more slowly.
set.bannerHint: Leave empty to use the default text.
set.compatTip: Turn on if the window shows garbled or blank areas. Takes effect after a restart.
set.prewarmDesc: Reserves part of the graphics memory at startup to shorten the wait before processing begins.
set.statsDesc: Only an anonymous ID, the app version and the hardware acceleration mode are sent.
set.mouseDesc: Mouse button 4 goes back and button 5 goes forward between the pages on the left.
set.restartBody: Compatible rendering was changed. Restart the app to apply it.
set.keysHint: Click the button on the right, then press the new key combination. Press Esc to cancel or Backspace to clear. If the combination is already used by another action, that action's shortcut is cleared.
set.globalTip: When on, the shortcut also works in other apps. When off, it works only while this app is in the foreground.
set.hoverNote: Hover and selection style for text buttons such as comment actions, filters and page numbers.

more.boardSub: The left column lists sources, the middle column lists items, the right column edits the selected item, and the bottom shows what is playing.
more.editNote: The name, number, range and shortcut are edited in the right column.
more.editEmpty: Select an item in the list to edit it.
more.effectLogs: Earlier records will be unavailable for troubleshooting
more.effectTrash: Deleted items can no longer be restored
more.effectResume: After deletion, work cannot resume from the last progress
more.effectRedo: You will need to process again from the start
more.starterSub: Recommended items appear when there is no content yet. Download progress shows in place and can be cancelled at any time.

text.sub: How interface text is written, with a wrong and a right example for each rule.

history.sub: Established designs that have been replaced, newest first.

rules.tipText: Adjusts the volume sent to speakers or headphones.
